description: This file declares utility functions, structures, and classes for handling OpenSSL SSL/TLS operations, error mapping, and logging within the Chromium project.

classes.name: SslSetClearMask
classes.description: Utility struct for managing SSL option and mode masks.

classes.name: OpenSSLErrorInfo
classes.description: Struct to store details about an OpenSSL error stack entry.

methods.name: OpenSSLPutNetError
methods.description: Logs a net error to the OpenSSL error stack with source location.

methods.name: SslSetClearMask
methods.description: Constructor and method to configure SSL option masks.

methods.name: ConfigureFlag
methods.description: Sets or clears a specific SSL option flag.

methods.name: MapOpenSSLError
methods.description: Converts an OpenSSL error code into a net error code.

methods.name: MapOpenSSLErrorWithDetails
methods.description: Converts an OpenSSL error code into a net error code with detailed info.

methods.name: NetLogOpenSSLError
methods.description: Logs an OpenSSL error to the net log.

methods.name: GetNetSSLVersion
methods.description: Returns the SSL version number for a given SSL connection.

methods.name: SetSSLChainAndKey
methods.description: Configures SSL with a certificate and key or custom key.
